title: Citrus Sorbet
blurb: A light, refreshing frozen dessert made with freshly squeezed orange and grapefruit juice, churned to a smooth texture.
steps: Put the water and sugar in a small pan and heat gently, stirring until the sugar dissolves completely.
Bring to a simmer for two minutes, then remove from the heat and leave to cool.
Strain the orange juice and grapefruit juice through a sieve into a large bowl.
Stir in the cooled sugar syrup and salt until combined.
Whisk the egg whites until they form soft peaks, then gently fold them into the citrus mixture.
Pour into a shallow freezer-proof container and freeze for about two hours, stirring every thirty minutes to break up ice crystals.
Once frozen to a scoopable consistency, transfer to the fridge for ten minutes before serving to soften slightly.
